name_zh: 中亚·帖木儿：征服帝国与文化融合
name_en: Central Asia Timur: Conquest Empire & Cultural Fusion
description_zh: 帖木儿 (1336-1405) 帖木儿帝国建立者，以撒马尔罕为都，征服中东、南亚、高加索、伏尔加草原，建立跨越欧亚大陆帝国，同时推动伊斯兰建筑、天文学、波斯文学繁荣，形成独特的征服与文化融合双重遗产。
description_en: Timur (1336-1405) Timurid Empire founder, with Samarkand as capital, conquered Middle East, South Asia, Caucasus, Volga steppe, built trans-Eurasian empire, simultaneously promoted Islamic architecture, astronomy, Persian literature prosperity, forming unique conquest and cultural fusion dual legacy.
reason_zh: 帖木儿代表中亚游牧征服者向定居文明转型的巅峰，展示了军事征服如何与文化建设同步推进，其帝国虽短命但为后世莫卧儿帝国与乌兹别克汗国奠基。
reason_en: Timur represents Central Asian nomadic conqueror transition to settled civilization peak, demonstrating how military conquest advances simultaneously with cultural construction, his empire though short-lived founded later Mughal Empire and Uzbek Khanate.
steps_zh: 研究帖木儿早年巴尔拉斯部贵族与跛足传说
分析1370年库里台大会建立帝国与撒马尔罕建都
探讨征服德里苏丹国安纳托利亚奥斯曼与金帐汗国
评估帖木儿建筑风格与乌鲁格别克天文台科学遗产
总结帖木儿帝国分裂与后世莫卧儿乌兹别克双重传承
steps_en: Study Timur early Barlas tribe nobility and lameness legend
Analyze 1370 Kurultai conference established empire and Samarkand capital
Explore conquest of Delhi Sultanate Anatolia Ottomans and Golden Horde
Evaluate Timurid architecture and Ulugh Beg Observatory scientific legacy
Summarize Timurid empire fragmentation and later Mughal Uzbek dual inheritance
expected_zh: 理解征服者如何成为文化建设者，掌握中亚帝国建构的军事-文化双重逻辑，评估帖木儿对早期现代欧亚地缘政治的深远重塑。
expected_en: Understand how conqueror becomes culture builder, grasp Central Asian empire construction military-cultural dual logic, evaluate Timur profound reshaping of early modern Eurasian geopolitics.
case_zh: 1336 帖木儿生于沙赫里萨布兹；1370 称汗建都撒马尔罕；1405 远征中国途中逝世。征服帝国文化融合范式永存。
case_en: 1336 Timur born in Shakhrisabz; 1370 declared Khan capital Samarkand; 1405 died en route to China. Conquest empire cultural fusion paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Trans-Eurasian empire; Islamic architecture; astronomy; Mughal/Uzbek inheritance
artistic_legacy: 是: 帖木儿建筑/波斯细密画
